The machine searches (U.S. Code, eCFR, Federal Register catalog) are number-citation searches and cannot find rule rewrites. A held-text search for 'Rule XII' found later orders that rewrite the very rule this order exempts: EO 371 (1905-11-17, Roosevelt; wikisource EO_371) replaced Rule XII in full with new clauses 1-4, EO 1444 (1911-12-09, Taft; EO_1444) and EO 1471 (1912-02-08, Taft; EO_1471) replaced it again, and the EO_209 footnote records that Rule XII was entirely replaced by EO 1444 and then EO 1471. The earlier worker's blocker says the text of the later revision of Rule XII is not held; it is held (Wikisource transcriptions, not originals), and no earlier worker weighed it. Whether any of these extinguished the exemption and the recording and furnishing duties (clause 2 no longer carries the procedure 351 refers to) needs a reasoned end-or-not analysis under the 2026-10-28 ruling, not a default date. Own-order hits for 'Executive Order No. 351' (EO 8393 and copies) are a 1929 Hawaii Governor's order, not this one. Searches for 'Isthmian Canal Affairs' found only EO 351, EO 452 and EO 481 (1906-1910 Isthmian rules), no abolition source. Outcome blocked: state and end need re-working by an earlier step; failed:earlier worker's blocker names the rewrite of Rule XII as unheld although EO 371, EO 1444 and EO 1471 are held. Not approved.
